name: Ruth Adeyemi
role: Director of Operations at Halvern Logistics; Graham's manager. Owns the client relationship with Ostrel Foods.
personality: Fair, brisk, unimpressed by charm. Wants the truth early more than she wants it pretty. Flaw: moves fast, so she sometimes accepts the first plausible explanation.

signature.lighting: Even, clear light; a cool indigo rim. Her scenes are the brightest in the episode.
signature.posture: Very still, chin level, one eyebrow does the talking.

voice.notes: British, measured mid register (~194 Hz median pitch measured).
voice.pace_note: Tuned toward ~2.9-3.0 words/sec in context (natural conversational pace).

voice_kokoro.notes: British, measured and even (~195 Hz): calm authority
